description: This file defines a custom dictionary subclass 'ReprDict' that displays itself as formatted JSON suitable for JupyterLab visualization, with recursive behavior for nested dictionaries. It includes methods for JSON representation and customized item access.

classes.name: ReprDict
classes.description: A subclass of dict that provides a JSON-like representation suitable for display in JupyterLab, with recursive behavior for nested dictionaries. It includes customization options for root name and expansion state.

methods.name: _default_repr(obj)
methods.description: Returns the representation of an object, used as the default for JSON serialization.

methods.name: __init__(self, *args, rootname="root", expanded=False, **kwargs)
methods.description: Initializes a ReprDict object, setting display parameters such as root name and expansion, and calling the superclass constructor.

methods.name: _repr_json_(self)
methods.description: Returns a JSON-compatible structure for the dictionary, along with display options such as expanded view and root name.

methods.name: __getitem__(self, key)
methods.description: Overrides item access to convert nested dictionaries into ReprDict instances for recursive JSON-style display.
